definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body

value: Coordinate dental services to meet the oral health needs of the patient
Examine, evaluate and diagnose diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and adjacent and associated structures
Treat diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures
Provide services to prevent diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures
Fabricate, repair or alter a dental prosthesis
Administer anesthesia in accordance with the provisions of article four-a of this chapter
Prescribe drugs necessary for the practice of dentistry
Execute and sign a death certificate when it is required in the practice of dentistry
Employ and supervise dental auxiliary personnel
Authorize delegated procedures to be performed by dental auxiliary personnel
Perform any other work included in the curriculum of an approved dental school, college or dental department of a university
methods_authorized.quote: The practice of dentistry includes the following: (1) Coordinate dental services to meet the oral health needs of the patient; (2) Examine, evaluate and diagnose diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: Prescribe drugs necessary for the practice of dentistry
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe drugs necessary for the practice of dentistry

value: Class 2 Permit (anxiolysis/minimal sedation)
Class 3a Permit (limited enteral conscious sedation/moderate sedation)
Class 3b Permit (comprehensive parenteral conscious sedation/moderate sedation)
Class 4 Permit (general anesthesia/deep conscious sedation)
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Class 2 Permit: A Class 2 Permit authorizes a dentist to induce anxiolysis/minimal sedation. Class 3 Permit: A Class 3 Permit authorizes a dentist to induce conscious sedation/moderate sedation as limited enteral (3a) and/or comprehensive parenteral (3b) and anxiolysis/minimal sedation. Class 4 Permit: A Class 4 Permit authorizes a dentist to induce general anesthesia/deep conscious sedation, conscious sedation/moderate sedation and anxiolysis/minimal sedation.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Prior to issuing a permit, the board shall conduct an on-site inspection of facility, equipment and auxiliary personnel of the applicant to determine if, in fact, all the requirements for the permit have been met.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: If a death, any serious complication or any injury occurs which may have resulted from the administration of general anesthesia/deep conscious sedation, conscious sedation/moderate sedation, anxiolysis/minimal sedation, or relative analgesia/minimal sedation, the licensee performing the dental procedure shall submit a written detailed report to the board within seventy-two hours of the incident

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: Holds valid and current documentation showing successful completion of a Health Care Provider BLS/CPR course, ACLS and/or a PALS course if treating pediatric patients

specialist_license_available.quote: The Board of Dentistry may issue a dental specialty license authorizing a dentist to represent himself or herself to the public as a specialist, and to practice as a specialist

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: The licensee shall limit his or her practice of dentistry only to the specialty or specialties in which he or she is licensed and in which he or she holds himself or herself out to the public as a specialist.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: Advertisements for teledentistry services must include the following disclaimer, in a conspicuous location, stating the limitations and safety concerns regarding teledentistry

value: Direct supervision
General supervision
Public health practice (direct, general, or no supervision as designated by rule)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision provided by a licensed dentist who is physically present in the dental office or treatment facility when procedures are being performed;..."General supervision" means a dentist is not required to be in the office or treatment facility when procedures are being performed, has personally authorized the procedures to be completed, and will evaluate the treatment provided at a future appointment by the dental auxiliary personnel;..."Public health practice" means treatment or procedures in a public health setting which shall be designated by a rule promulgated by the board to require direct, general, or no supervision of a dental hygienist by a dentist;

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Place sealants on a patient's teeth without a prior examination by a licensed dentist: Provided, That for this subdivision, the dental hygienist has a public health practice permit issued by the board, and subject to a collaborative agreement with a supervising dentist

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: the dental hygienist has a public health practice permit issued by the board, and subject to a collaborative agreement with a supervising dentist and the patient is referred for a dental examination within six months of sealant application

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: "Public health setting" means hospitals, schools, correctional facilities, jails, community clinics, long-term care facilities, nursing homes, home health agencies, group homes, state institutions under the Department of Health Facilities, public health facilities, homebound settings, accredited dental hygiene education programs, and any other place designated by the board by rule

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation or professional limited liability company may practice dentistry, or any of its branches, or hold itself out as being capable of doing so without a certificate of authorization from the board.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: "Work authorization" means a written order for dental laboratory services which has been issued by a licensed dentist.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth by a provider who is located at a distant site to facilitate the diagnosis, treatment, education, care management, and self-management of or consultation with a patient who is located at an originating site.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: dentists and dental hygienists with a local anesthesia certificate, may administer vaccines, perform FDA-authorized diagnostic tests

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Holds valid and current documentation showing successful completion of a Health Care Provider BLS/CPR

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: "Dental hygienist" means a person licensed by the board to practice and who provides dental hygiene and other services as specified by the board by rule to patients in the dental office and in a public health setting
